subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): import legacy auth-profiles.json into SQLite store on load

question: Should legacy `auth-profiles.json` be imported during normal auth runtime loads, or must recovery stay in doctor/startup migration before runtime reads?
rationale: The reported auth-loss upgrade problem is real, but the PR crosses a credential-bearing migration boundary where current source, tests, docs, and repository policy keep legacy JSON out of steady-state runtime loads.

options.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
options.body: Rework the fix into doctor or an explicit startup/update migration boundary that verifies SQLite persistence and handles legacy JSON cleanup or preservation.

options.title: Approve Runtime Import
options.body: Accept runtime fallback only with maintainer/security approval plus updated invariant tests, docs, and a clear stale-credential threat model.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Issue
options.body: Pause or close this branch while the broader migration and fallback diagnostics continue under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100067.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
recommendation.body: Rework the fix into doctor or an explicit startup/update migration boundary that verifies SQLite persistence and handles legacy JSON cleanup or preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current-main history signal for the SQLite auth persistence boundary that the decision changes.
